name: tw-legal-benchmark-v1
description:
Taiwan Legal Benchmark v1
	

A multiple-choice benchmark for evaluating large language models on Taiwan law in Traditional Chinese (繁體中文). It covers six legal domains with 209 questions drawn from Taiwan bar exam and certification-style questions.
